paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar (tip of red-giant branch) bound on axion-electron Yukawa coupling from anomalous cooling of the degenerate helium core. Mass-independent bound valid for axion masses well below the core temperature (~few keV), encoded as a horizontal line. Best bound g_ae < 1.3e-13 (95% CL) from omega Centauri; NGC 4258 gives g_ae < 1.6e-13 (95% CL). 68% CL bounds are ~0.64e-13 (omega Cen) and ~0.79e-13 (NGC 4258). Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Paper also constrains neutrino magnetic dipole moment (mu_nu < 1.2e-12 mu_B) but the requested coupling is AxionElectron. | selector: text (sole candidate)
